result.title: TLAPS-Bench: Formally Proving Correctness of Real-World System Specifications with TLA+ Proof System
result.comment: 35 pages (10-page main text, references, and appendix), 7 figures, 20 tables. Benchmark and harness: https://github.com/specula-org/TLAPS-Bench
result.summary: TLAPS-Bench is a benchmark and execution harness for constructing machine-checked proofs for real-world system specifications in TLA+ with agentic AI. Proving correctness of complex system specifications requires discovering inductive invariants, reasoning about intricate state transitions, and decomposing proofs into tractable obligations. TLAPS-Bench provides a proof harness that supports iterative proof development atop the TLA+ Proof System (TLAPS), where agents are equipped with proof tools and libraries, with safeguards against reward hacking. Using the harness, we have employed AI agents to prove desired properties for important system specifications that were not proved before, spanning cache coherence, Byzantine consensus, and write-ahead logs. TLAPS-Bench contains 265 proof targets (each encodes a property to prove) from 95 TLA+ specifications of real-world systems. We evaluated frontier AI agents, represented by Codex with GPT models, on a subset of 70 proof targets across 12 specifications. The highest-scoring model, GPT-6.1 Sol (max), proved 31 (44.3%) proof targets. The results show challenges and opportunities in end-to-end proof development.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 TLAPS-Bench：一个面向真实系统 TLA+ 规格的机器可检验证明基准与执行框架，含 265 个证明目标（来自 95 个规格），并评测前沿 agent 的端到端证明开发能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「发现归纳不变量、拆分证明义务、由检查器逐步判定」的流程，可能与 LVR 中的中间状态验证、子目标分解及停止决策有概念类比，但无视觉与多模态成分，迁移线索较远、可供核查。
